verdict.rationale: The docs show that chargeback funds are automatically deducted from the wallet and returned to the user, with a dispute created that the platform can sometimes contest. They also note the platform may be asked to settle its credit to Mangopay, which implies the platform ultimately carries the liability. Nothing in the pack covers balances that go short or how the shortfall is recovered. missing for 10: handling of refunds/chargebacks that exceed the seller's wallet balance, automatic debits against future seller earnings, direct debit of the seller's bank account, explicit documentation of the liability order between seller, platform and Mangopay, independent corroboration.
